label: Guardian Green
description: Deep, trustworthy green with warm gold — for financial advisors, insurance and wealth planners. Poppins headings with Mukta body text; both render Hindi (Devanagari) as well as English.
notes: Sampled from the RSSAHU FINMART shield logo (deep green + gold). The gold is used for accents and lines only; `accent` is the same gold darkened along its hue so it can carry text. Pairs with the pillars, calculators, quiz, steps and social sections.
